title: Carneddau (Black Ladders) Wellington Memorial
memorial_type: Protected war grave with wreckage; crash site cairn
narrative: Flying a training exercise from RAF Lichfield, the crew of Wellington Mk.IC DV800 were undertaking a navigational flight over Wales when conditions deteriorated. The pilot, Sergeant Longbottom, was Australian — one of many Commonwealth aircrew training with 27 OTU at the time. All five crew members were killed, including Sergeant Traylen, Sergeant Bowen, and Sergeant Wilson. There were no survivors.

crew.name: Eric Harvey Longbottom
crew.fate_detail: Killed on impact. Buried at Caernarfon Cemetery alongside fellow Australian Bannister.

crew.name: Lionel Denis Traylen
crew.fate_detail: Killed on impact at Black Ladders.

crew.name: Richard Ivor Bowen
crew.fate_detail: Killed on impact at Black Ladders.

crew.name: Samuel James Wilson
crew.fate_detail: Killed on impact. Last radio contact at 12:06.

cause_of_loss: Navigation error in cloud; aircraft flew up valley from Bethesda into the mountainside at ~2,500 ft
memorial_details: The crash site on Black Ladders is treated as a protected war grave. Wreckage remains scattered on the mountainside. Very remote, requiring experienced mountain walking.

external_narratives.summary: Detailed crash site analysis. Aircraft strayed 10 miles off course.
key_details: Crash site not found for 10 days
